methodology: Source review confirms what the cited report states, not independent ground truth. Dates describe source coverage, not refresh time. Historical map coverage is selective; coordinates are approximate locality references, not verified impact coordinates.

iran_killed.label: Iran Deaths Documented by HRANA
iran_killed.scope: 28 February-7 April 2026: 1,701 civilian, 1,221 military and 714 unclassified deaths. Not a September total.
iran_killed.verification_note: Sum of HRANA's three non-overlapping categories; classifications remain subject to revision.

iran_injured.label: Iran Injuries Reported by Health Ministry
iran_injured.source_name: WHO EMRO, situation report 6, citing Iran MoH
iran_injured.scope: Ministry total through 7 April, published by WHO on 16 April. Not independently verified or a September count.
iran_injured.verification_note: WHO reports more than 32,314 injuries; no severity-specific breakdown used.

israel_killed.label: Deaths in Israel from Direct Missile / Rocket Strikes
israel_killed.source_name: Ynet, Operation Roaring Lion casualty review
israel_killed.scope: First 40 days, ending at the April ceasefire. Includes fire from Iran and Lebanon and victims of different nationalities. Excludes combat abroad and indirect deaths.
israel_killed.verification_note: Uses the explicit 22 direct-strike deaths, not the broader 42-person war-related tally.

israel_injured.label: Israel Hospital Evacuations Reported
israel_injured.scope: Operation Roaring Lion cumulative hospital evacuations through 17 April, 07:00 local time. Broader than confirmed direct-strike wounds.
israel_injured.verification_note: Official bulletin reports 7,834 injured persons evacuated to hospitals; 78 remained hospitalized.

us_killed.label: US Service Member Deaths Reported
us_killed.scope: Combined Operation Epic Fury and subsequent Overseas Operations tally. Includes operational deaths, not only hostile-fire deaths.
us_killed.verification_note: Published tally of 18; not a live September count.

us_seriously_injured.label: US Service Members Wounded (All Severities)
us_seriously_injured.scope: Epic Fury and Overseas Operations combined. Replaces the incorrect seriously-injured label. Not a September live count.
us_seriously_injured.verification_note: Article reports 757 overall, although its service subtotals sum to 756. Displayed as a reported claim, not an audited total.

missiles_total_2026.label: Missiles UAE Reports Intercepting
missiles_total_2026.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence via Khaleej Times
missiles_total_2026.scope: UAE only: 537 ballistic plus 26 cruise missiles since the conflict began. Replaces the unsupported regional launch total; not impact sites.
missiles_total_2026.verification_note: Official interception claim, not independently established interceptions or all Iranian launches.

drones_total_2026.label: Drones UAE Reports Intercepting
drones_total_2026.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence via Khaleej Times
drones_total_2026.scope: UAE cumulative claim. Replaces the unsupported region-wide drone launch count. Does not establish individual map locations.
drones_total_2026.verification_note: The cited report attributes 2,256 interceptions to UAE air defence.

air_strikes_total_2026.label: US-Israeli Strike Events (ACLED)
air_strikes_total_2026.source_name: ACLED Iran crisis data, 10 September release
air_strikes_total_2026.scope: 28 February-7 September. Location/day events include air, missile and drone attacks, including interceptions; not individual weapons or solely airstrikes.
air_strikes_total_2026.verification_note: ACLED's published cumulative event count; subject to verification and revision.

air_defense_intercepts_7d.label: UAE Air Defence Engagements
air_defense_intercepts_7d.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence via Gulf Today
air_defense_intercepts_7d.scope: UAE cumulative engagements through 27 March 2026: 378 ballistic missiles + 15 cruise missiles + 1,835 UAVs. Not confirmed interceptions or a region-wide total.
air_defense_intercepts_7d.verification_note: The cited report supports the sum 2,228 and uses engaged, not destroyed. Official claim, not independently verified.

critical_infrastructure_impacts_7d.label: Iran Civilian Properties Reported Damaged
critical_infrastructure_impacts_7d.scope: Iranian Red Crescent claim through 31 March 2026. Includes homes and commercial premises, not only critical infrastructure. Not independently verified.
critical_infrastructure_impacts_7d.verification_note: Report states more than 113,000 civilian places damaged. No current September total established.

russia_killed_reported.label: Russian Military Deaths (CSIS Estimate)
russia_killed_reported.source_name: Center for Strategic and International Studies
russia_killed_reported.scope: Estimated range for February 2022-June 2026. Not a named-person verified count or September total.

russia_injured_reported.label: Russian Military Casualties (CSIS Estimate)
russia_injured_reported.source_name: Center for Strategic and International Studies
russia_injured_reported.scope: February 2022-June 2026; includes killed, wounded and missing. Replaces the unsupported wounded-only count. Deaths are already included; do not add the cards.
russia_injured_reported.verification_note: No wounded-only estimate can be derived by subtracting fatalities because missing personnel are included.

ukraine_strike_incidents_7d.label: Air and Drone Strike Events
ukraine_strike_incidents_7d.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Event counts, not individual weapons.
ukraine_strike_incidents_7d.verification_note: Published weekly ACLED count, subject to revision.

critical_infra_impacts_7d_ua.label: Russian Attacks on Civilian Infrastructure
critical_infra_impacts_7d_ua.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Attack events, not unique damaged facilities.
critical_infra_impacts_7d_ua.verification_note: Infrastructure subcategories overlap and must not be summed.

frontline_pressure_index.label: Armed Clashes (Weekly Events)
frontline_pressure_index.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Replaces the unsupported pressure index with a documented event count.
frontline_pressure_index.verification_note: Not a percentage, territorial gain measure or intensity score.

ukraine_energy_sites_damaged_30d.label: Energy Infrastructure Attack Events (Weekly)
ukraine_energy_sites_damaged_30d.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Replaces the unsupported 30-day damaged-site count; events can affect the same site more than once.
ukraine_energy_sites_damaged_30d.verification_note: Energy-tagged events are a subset of infrastructure attacks, not additional events.

ukraine_displaced_population_m.label: Internally Displaced People in Ukraine
ukraine_displaced_population_m.source_name: IOM estimate via UNHCR data portal
ukraine_displaced_population_m.scope: People displaced within Ukraine as of 30 June. Excludes refugees abroad; displayed in people, not millions.
ukraine_displaced_population_m.verification_note: Survey-based population estimate, not a complete individual registry.

ukr_civilians_killed_reported.label: Ukraine Civilian Deaths Verified by OHCHR
ukr_civilians_killed_reported.source_name: OHCHR / UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission
ukr_civilians_killed_reported.scope: Cumulative verified civilian deaths since 24 February 2022, as reported 13 August 2026. Excludes military deaths; actual total likely higher.
ukr_civilians_killed_reported.verification_note: UN release explicitly reports this cumulative verified minimum. This is not a September live count.

ukr_civilians_injured_reported.label: Ukraine Civilian Injuries Verified by OHCHR
ukr_civilians_injured_reported.source_name: OHCHR / UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission
ukr_civilians_injured_reported.scope: Cumulative verified civilian injuries since 24 February 2022, as reported 13 August 2026. Excludes military injuries; actual total likely higher.
ukr_civilians_injured_reported.verification_note: UN release explicitly reports this cumulative verified minimum. This is not a September live count.

metric_gaps.total_reported_killed: No comparable regional total: reviewed reports cover different dates, countries and direct/indirect deaths. Adding these cards would misrepresent coverage.
metric_gaps.total_reported_injured: No comparable regional total: hospital evacuations and wounded-person reports use different definitions and dates. The country reports remain available separately.
metric_gaps.conflict_duration_days: Elapsed time since 28 February is not active combat duration: ceasefires and subsequent operations interrupt the period. No continuous-war duration asserted.
metric_gaps.ukraine_intercepts_7d: No substantiated seven-day interception total for the reviewed week. ACLED strike events include attacks, not a successful-interception count.
metric_gaps.ukraine_drone_wave_incidents_7d: No separately substantiated drone-wave count. The documented combined air/drone event count is shown under operations; a wave and a location/day event are not equivalent.
metric_gaps.ukraine_frontline_settlement_changes_7d: No independently reconciled weekly settlement-change count. ACLED describes advances but warns of exaggerated control claims; armed clashes do not measure territorial changes.

historical_events.name: Kramatorsk railway station missile attack
historical_events.source: SITU Research / Human Rights Watch investigation
historical_events.verification_note: Joint investigation dates the railway station attack to 8 April 2022. City-level marker rather than exact detonation coordinates.

historical_events.name: Hroza funeral reception missile attack
historical_events.source: OHCHR / UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission
historical_events.verification_note: OHCHR investigation identifies the 5 October 2023 reception attack and assesses a likely Iskander missile. Approximate village reference.

historical_events.name: Minab school missile strike
historical_events.source: OHCHR experts statement, reproduced by ecoi.net
historical_events.verification_note: UN experts describe the school strike on 28 February and call for investigation. Attribution and casualty reports are not treated as independently settled. Approximate city reference.

historical_events.name: Tel Aviv apartment missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: Report dates the apartment strike to 28 February. City reference, not an exact impact point.

historical_events.name: Yehud workplace missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: Report identifies a workplace strike on 9 March. Approximate locality reference.

historical_events.name: Ramat Gan apartment missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: Report identifies the apartment strike on 18 March. City reference only.

historical_events.name: Haifa residential building missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: Occurrence date is 5 April, not the subsequent recovery of victims. Approximate city reference.

historical_events.name: Fujairah oil facility drone attack
historical_events.source: Belga / Brussels Times, citing UAE authorities
historical_events.verification_note: Authorities report a drone attack and fire on 4 May. Attribution is an official claim; marker is a Fujairah locality reference, not the facility coordinates.

historical_events.name: Kyiv drone and ballistic missile attack
historical_events.source: ACLED Ukraine weekly update, 29 August-4 September
historical_events.verification_note: ACLED dates the combined attack to 31 August. One city reference for the reported attack, not a marker for every weapon.

historical_events.name: Tamra residential missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: HRW documents a residential missile impact in Tamra on 14 June. Locality-level marker; exact impact coordinates not asserted.

historical_events.name: Bat Yam apartment missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: HRW documents the 15 June apartment strike using site visits, witnesses and geolocated footage. City-level marker.

historical_events.name: Petah Tikva residential missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: HRW documents the 16 June strike through witnesses and verified CCTV. City-level marker.

historical_events.name: Soroka Medical Center missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: HRW documents a direct hospital impact on 19 June. Approximate Be'er Sheva locality marker, not the impact point.

historical_events.name: Be'er Sheva apartment missile strike
historical_events.verification_note: HRW documents the 24 June residential strike using witnesses and verified footage. City-level marker.

historical_events.name: Port Shuaiba drone attack
historical_events.source: U.S. Department of War, 3 March 2026 release
historical_events.verification_note: Official casualty notification identifies a 1 March UAS attack in Port Shuaiba, Kuwait. Incident was under investigation. Approximate port-area marker.

historical_events.name: Okhmatdyt Children's Hospital strike
historical_events.verification_note: MSF reports the hospital was hit on 8 July 2024. Approximate Kyiv locality marker; no exact time or impact coordinate asserted.

historical_events.name: Missile and drone attack mainly affecting Kyiv
historical_events.source: OHCHR / UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission
historical_events.verification_note: UN release identifies a 2 July attack mainly striking Kyiv. One city-level reference for the attack, not one marker per weapon or casualty.
